reuse.why: Uses the existing getMonthWideCategories selection plus getSheetValue, setBudget and batchMessages like the sibling month-wide actions.

duplication.why: Repeats the income/tracking guard and a sign flip inline, the same per-action idiom every sibling uses because the helper does not own the income rule.

placement.why: Action lives in budget/actions.ts next to setZero and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)).

scope.why: Action, registration and focused tests only.

maintainability.why: Readable and conventional, with one more copy of the income guard to keep in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: category set from getMonthWideCategories; the income guard has no shared owner in this tree

disguised_duplication.where: the income guard is a plain verbatim copy of the siblings' guard
